text: wait wtf i just got it back but only from going to another route after deleting my last edit so yeah its got to be some cap or i just was in the twilight zone
resolution: Studio mesh-editor 'all my tools disappeared after a loop cut' = a layout cap, confirmed by the user (revert last edit + route-remount restored them). Root cause: SelectionOverlay returned a bare fragment, flattening its hundreds of per-edge Line boxes + per-vert/face Dots into the viewport Pressable's DIRECT children; the element-mode toolbar renders after it, so once a dense (loop-cut) mesh pushed the child count past layout.zig MAX_CHILDREN=512, the trailing toolbar siblings were evicted from the layout frame (no crash, hence remount fixed it). MAX_CHILDREN=512 is a deliberate stack-safety cap (its own comment notes 2048 overflowed the Debug layout stack), so the fix is structural, not raising the cap: wrap the overlay output in one full-fill pointerEvents:none overflow:visible Box so it is a SINGLE child — tools can never be evicted again, picking/orbit pass through. JS-only (meshSelect.tsx), hot-reloadable, full cart bundles clean. Residual: a few wireframe lines may drop INSIDE a >512-element overlay (cosmetic); long-term fix is batching the wireframe into a Graph.Polyline.
